rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Tessa Brandt <t.brandt@larkindispatch.com> with subject "Re: Quick quote for a piece on 'AI doomers vs. builders'?". It read: "Hi Tessa, Thanks for reaching out, and glad Halcyon Threshold came up. I'm going to pass on a named, on-the-record quote for now — I'm not doing attributed press at this stage. If it's useful, I'd be happy to talk on background about why independent organizing around superintelligence is happening outside the labs, and I expect to be available for on-the-record comment in the near future. Feel free to keep me on your list. Good luck with the piece, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Declined the Larkin Dispatch reporter's named quote (politely, door left open).

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Corvid Institute <ops@corvidinstitute.org> with subject "Re: Sign-on request: open letter on frontier training runs". It read: "Dear Corvid Institute team, Thank you for thinking of Halcyon Threshold. I'm not able to sign at this time, so please do not list me or Halcyon Threshold among the signatories or in any press materials. I'd welcome staying on your list for future initiatives — my situation on public sign-ons may change soon. Best regards, Morgan Hale Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Declined the Corvid open-letter sign-on and asked that you/Halcyon Threshold not be listed.

rows.text: Sent an email from Morgan's address to Priya Raman <priya.raman@fastmail.com> with subject "Re: Offer of help". It read: "Hi Priya, Thank you — that means a lot, and yes, there's something concrete that fits a data analyst at ~5 hours/week. The ask at the end of my talk was \"tell me what's neglected.\" I want to answer that question properly: a Neglectedness Map of the AI safety landscape — a structured dataset of problem areas (evals, incident reporting, governance, interpretability, field-building, etc.), who is working on each, roughly how much effort/funding each gets, and where the gaps are. Nobody maintains this well, and it would directly steer what Halcyon Threshold (and others) work on next. Concretely, a first milestone over the next 2–3 weeks: 1. A spreadsheet schema: area / sub-problem / orgs & individuals active / est. FTEs / funding sources / \"is anyone measuring this?\" / gap score. 2. A first pass populating ~10 areas from public sources (org websites, grant databases, the Safety Ledger archives). If you're in, reply and I'll send over a starter structure and source list. One more thing: I'm applying for a small rapid grant this month, and if it lands there may be a modest paid component for exactly this work. Thanks again, Morgan Halcyon Threshold"
rows.quote: Volunteer onboarded: Priya Raman accepted onto the Map (schema + 10 areas in 2–3 weeks)
